title: Air-fryer roasted peppers
subtitle: Whole peppers blistered in the air fryer and peeled for sweet, smoky flesh.
excerpt: Whole red and yellow peppers air-fried at high heat until blistered all over, then steamed in a covered bowl so the skins slip off. The flesh is sweet, slightly smoky, and ready for salads, pasta, or jars. Serves four.
sourceNotes: Roasted and peeled sweet peppers (pimientos asados in Spanish, peperoni arrostiti in Italian) are a preparation across Mediterranean cooking. They are used as a component in salads, pasta sauces, and antipasti, or stored in oil.

recipe.batchNotes: Roast in batches and store in oil in the fridge for up to 5 days.

content.text: Roasting whole peppers in the air fryer takes 20 minutes and produces skins that blister and char evenly on all sides. The key step is what happens afterwards: sealing the hot peppers in a covered bowl for 15 minutes creates steam that loosens the skin, making it easy to peel. Without this step, peeling is a slow and wasteful job.

items.prepNote: or a mix of red and yellow

content.text: Place the {{pepper-red}} whole peppers in the air fryer basket ,  no oil needed. Cook at 200°C for 10 minutes, turn with tongs, and cook for a further 10 minutes until blistered and charred in places on all sides. Transfer immediately to a heatproof bowl and cover tightly with a plate or cling film. Leave for 15 minutes. The steam inside will loosen the skins.

Peel away the skins ,  they should slip off easily. Cut each pepper in half, remove the core and seeds, and tear or slice the flesh into strips. Dress with {{olive-oil}} of olive oil and {{sea-salt-flakes}} of flaked salt if using immediately, or store in oil in a sealed container in the fridge.

items.cause: Peppers not steamed long enough after cooking.
items.fix: Seal the bowl immediately after removing from the fryer and wait the full 15 minutes. If skins still resist, leave for another 5 minutes.

items.cause: Temperature too low or basket overcrowded.
items.fix: Cook at 200°C with peppers not touching each other so the circulating air can reach all sides.

items.symptom: Peppers still firm and not cooked through
items.fix: Large peppers may need up to 25 minutes total. They are ready when a skewer goes through the skin without resistance.

content.text: Roasted peppers from the air fryer are a useful component. Add to pasta with anchovies and capers, layer into sandwiches, stir through risotto, or arrange on a board as part of an antipasti spread. In a sealed jar covered with olive oil, they keep in the fridge for up to 5 days.
